Remark
[Conformal Synge--Weinstein theorem] 1. ch9:3.9The conclusion of section 2 remains valid when $f$ is a conformal diffeomorphism. Extending it to arbitrary diffeomorphisms would preclude positive sectional curvature on $S^2\times S^2$, because the product of the antipodal maps is orientation-preserving and fixed-point free.
